title: Reply: absent qualia cases refute only crude functional theories, and rest on prejudice

statements.text: Some theorists answer that absent qualia scenarios are clear counterexamples only to crude functional theories, and that attention to more sophisticated characterizations undermines the intuition. Others suggest the intuition that such creatures lack qualia rests on prejudice against unfamiliar shapes, slow reactions or parts spread widely in space.

sources.quote: these scenarios provide clear-cut counterexamples only to crude functional theories
the intuition that these creatures lack qualia is based on prejudice
